title: Smart School Hub
overview: The Smart School Hub is a web-based school management system designed to streamline administrative and academic processes. It provides role-based portals for administrators, teachers, and students to manage user accounts, record attendance, enter grades, post announcements, and view academic records. The system centralizes core school operations into a single desktop web application.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Responsible for system administration, managing user accounts, assigning teachers to classes, making announcements, and generating reports.
roles.evidence_quote: Admin Interface: Administrators manage user accounts (students and teachers), assign teachers to classes, make system-wide announcements, and generate reports.

roles.name: Teacher
roles.description: Primary academic user responsible for taking student attendance, entering grades, and posting class announcements.
roles.evidence_quote: Teacher Interface: Teachers can log in, take student attendance, enter grades, and post announcements for their classes.

roles.name: Student
roles.description: Main audience who views attendance, grades, announcements, and customizes personal profile.
roles.evidence_quote: Student Interface: Students can log in to view attendance, announcements, grades, and customize their profiles.

requirements.title: User Authentication and Access Control
requirements.text: The system must securely handle authentication for pre-registered users for all roles (Admin, Teacher, Student) and maintain strict, role-based access control to ensure privacy.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system must securely handle authentication for pre- registered users for all roles (Admin, Teacher, Student) and maintain strict, role-based access control to ensure privacy.

requirements.title: Project Delivery Timeline
requirements.text: The entire initial version must be fully developed, tested, and delivered within a non-negotiable 7-week timeframe.
requirements.evidence_quote: The entire initial version must be fully developed, tested, and delivered within a non-negotiable 7-week timeframe.

requirements.title: Technology Stack Constraint
requirements.text: The system implementation is strictly constrained to Python (Django) for the backend, SQLite for the database, and React/HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend without substituting major frameworks or database systems without formal approval.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system implementation is strictly constrained to the fol- lowing stack: Python (Django) for the backend, SQLite for the database, and Re- act/HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.

requirements.title: Desktop Browser Platform Constraint
requirements.text: The application is constrained to operate only on latest versions of desktop web browsers.
requirements.evidence_quote: The application is constrained to operate only on desktop web browsers (latest versions).

requirements.title: Session-Based Authentication
requirements.text: User authentication must be implemented using session-based authentication in line with standard Django practices.
requirements.evidence_quote: User authentication must be implemented using session-based authentication, as opposed to token-based or third-party authentication, in line with standard Django practices.

requirements.title: User Role Definition Limit
requirements.text: The system must strictly adhere to three and only three defined user roles: Admin, Teacher, and Student.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system must strictly adhere to three and only three defined user roles (Admin, Teacher, Student).

requirements.title: Input Device Dependency
requirements.text: The UI design must assume interaction via a physical keyboard and mouse.
requirements.evidence_quote: The UI design must assume interaction via a physical keyboard and mouse.
